title: Day 10 Milestone — The Siren Map

setting.summary: A rusted emergency siren wakes the wasteland. Its pattern feels deliberate—like coordinates hiding in noise.

must_include: A repeating siren pattern that implies a location
A visible risk if the player stays exposed

beats.notes: Translate sound into a concrete lead (direction, landmark, or symbol).
Make both branches plausible: stand and defend vs. slip away and regroup.
